as_read: Oral reduced glutathione raises body stores in one 6-month RCT and small trials report mixed surrogate results, with no clinical benefit established; a human should rule, with no credit recommended.

studies_to_add.primary_endpoint: not named; whole body insulin sensitivity by clamp
studies_to_add.quote: Oral GSH supplementation improves insulin sensitivity in obese subjects with and without T2DM, although it does not alter markers of oxidative stress.

studies_to_add.primary_endpoint: not named; serum NO and IL-1 alpha, acne severity
studies_to_add.quote: At week 4, reductions in serum NO and IL-1α concentrations were observed in the glutathione group; however, these changes did not reach statistical significance (p > 0.05).
Oral glutathione supplementation did not impact growth or change serum or fecal inflammatory markers in pancreatic insufficient children with CF when compared with placebo.

stop_list: Liposomal, 3 labels: 294002 (Liposomal Glutathione Liquid, row Glutathione 100 mg), 184557 (Liposomal Recharge Liquid, row Glutathione 165 mg, 4 rows), 315656 (row Glutathione, Liposomal 500 mg). Two print liposomal only in the product name, so the excluded term on the row will not catch them. Read: 34150674 (no dose in abstract, oxidative stress and in vitro outcomes), 41559937 (open-label pharmacokinetics). Not settled by this packet.
S-Acetyl-L-Glutathione, 2 labels: 241943, 323065, 100 mg. No human efficacy trial among the search hits printed; 42683004 is a safety opinion. Not a full search, so no rejection proposed.

Setria L-Glutathione, 1 label: 227921, 500 mg. 41897500 names Setria as a bioavailability comparator and calls it liposomal; 24791752 names no material. No efficacy trial read names it. The stored record already says brand transfer isn't established.
Glutathione-SR, 1 label: 284225, 175 mg, row Glutathione. The label name suggests a modified form; what SR means was not read from the label row and is not assumed.
Label 184557 has 4 rows, and 294002 and 315656 have 2; the reviewed trials tested glutathione alone.
clinician_items: 42683004: EFSA panel concludes S-acetyl glutathione is safe at 300 mg/day for adults, excluding pregnant and lactating women, with lower limits for adolescents; notes perchlorate in the novel food below the TDI.
39444151: review says IV glutathione is contraindicated due to lack of efficacy and side effects, and describes minimal versus substantial adverse effects for topical versus oral.
41897500: no significant changes in ALT, AST, ALP or creatinine after 30 days at 600 mg/day of a micellar product, single arm.
stored_rating_note: Stored positive_strong on 24791752 rests on tissue glutathione levels, a biomarker. PubMed publication types don't index 35624890 as randomized, though its title says so.
unread_notes: Abstracts only. 2 searches used (175 and 67 hits), newest first and capped at 30 and 35, so older hits from the second search were not printed; a dedicated S-acetyl search is still owed before those 2 labels close. 41897500 was cut at 2100 characters, before its last sentence. 33966361 (liposomal), 42446814 (review), 42392376 (film pharmacokinetics), 37125500 and 37049398 (citrulline combinations), 40155786 (TB review) and 35310529 (olive polyphenols combination) were listed by search but not opened; none is cited.
